Context: FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

## FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS  
1. Can a Government servant be transferred to foreign service against his will?  
No Government servant may be transferred to foreign service  
against his will.  
2. Can an officer be allowed to accept employment in the form of assignment I consultancy when the period of the same is covered by grant of leave due and admissible, in view of provisions of Rule 13 of CCS (Leave) Rules which prohibits the same?
